destinations.title: Can negative-tension walls mediate vacuum decay in otherwise perturbatively stable theories, and does the fluctuation spectrum exclude apparently acausal bubble nucleation?
Can coupled scalar dynamics make vacuum bubbles singular, obstructing eternal inflation from populating flux vacua, and what potential conditions permit regular solutions?

Can different Brans–Dicke field values inside and outside a thin false-vacuum bubble produce negative effective shell tension and expanding bubbles visible to an exterior observer, beyond the Einstein-gravity solutions considered by the authors?

How do bubbles form and collide in false-vacuum eternal inflation, and which collision effects could be observable in cosmology? This is an introductory, deliberately noncomprehensive review with one proposed new spacetime solution.
Can positive-energy 4D FLRW cosmology and effective gravity emerge on an expanding decay bubble in AdS, without requiring a fundamental de Sitter vacuum or a scale-separated compactification?

Can a time-dependent bubble wall in decaying AdS₅ support effective four-dimensional de Sitter cosmology, temperature, matter and Einstein gravity without requiring a fundamental metastable de Sitter compactification?

How do black holes and string clouds alter gravitational vacuum-decay bounce actions, and can their catalytic effect favor creation of a four-dimensional bubble with a very small positive cosmological constant?

How do radially stretched strings produce finite four-dimensional gravity on an expanding AdS bubble despite divergent exterior volume, and how do these sources affect the sign of gravitational response and apparent time dependence of masses or Newton's constant?

Can five-dimensional quintessence catalyze metastable vacuum decay into a bubble carrying an expanding four-dimensional universe, and can catalytic selection plus the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture constrain its cosmological constant?

Can decaying string-theory vacua generate an effective (2+1)-dimensional de Sitter cosmology on an expanding bubble, without requiring a fundamental de Sitter vacuum, and do explicit flux parameters permit energetically viable nucleation?

Which gravitational instantons describe bubble-of-nothing decays of selected AdS backgrounds, and can a non-supersymmetric massive-IIA AdS4 vacuum possess such a decay channel despite reported perturbative and brane-jet stability?

Can a universe realized by thin-wall bubble nucleation during decay of a nonsupersymmetric AdS vacuum have a finite maximum radiation temperature and minimum size, and can string flux parameters and inflationary observations constrain those quantities?

Can a de Sitter universe inhabit an End-of-the-World (ETW) brane bounding spacetime nucleated from nothing, and can this description agree with up-tunnelling from infinitely negatively curved AdS after renormalization?

How does a large degeneracy of internal bubble microstates affect first-order-transition nucleation, the quantum state and evolution of materialized bubbles, and the gravitational radiation from their mergers?

Conditional on string theory being useful and the dark bubble scenario working, what consistency relations connect positive dark energy, extra-dimensional scales, short-distance gravity and cosmological history?
Can decay of a metastable de Sitter vacuum in a toy string landscape lead to contraction inside the decay bubble and, with an assumed singularity-avoiding modification, repeated cosmological cycles?
How does gravitation alter semiclassical false-vacuum nucleation and subsequent bubble growth, and how does the change in vacuum energy alter spacetime inside and outside the bubble?

sources.title: Kinematics of arbitrary spin matter fields in loop quantum gravity

evidence.text: How do the Gauss and spatial diffeomorphism constraints shape arbitrary-spin matter coupled to loop quantum gravity, and how far can this quantum kinematics be derived from classical higher-spin actions?

sources.title: Consistent canonical quantization of gravity: Recovery of classical GR from BRST-invariant coherent states

evidence.text: Can BRST canonical quantization recover classical GR constraints and vanishing bulk Hamiltonian expectation while retaining nontrivial time evolution of metric expectation values?

sources.title: Solution of quantum Dirac constraints via path integral

evidence.text: Does direct one-loop evaluation of the relativistically gauge-fixed path integral reproduce the semiclassical two-point kernel satisfying quantum Dirac constraints for generic first-class constrained systems?

sources.title: Kinematics of arbitrary spin matter fields in loop quantum gravity

evidence.text: Diffeomorphism averaging first projects over the finite graph-symmetry group, Pγ=|GSγ|⁻¹Σφ Uφ, then uses a rigging map into the dual space to average graph-moving diffeomorphisms.

sources.title: Consistent canonical quantization of gravity: Recovery of classical GR from BRST-invariant coherent states

evidence.text: Builds a canonical operator algebra and obtains Heisenberg equations for metric variables and momenta. Physical-state matrix elements, followed by coherent-state factorization and the ℏ→0 limit, extract the classical constraints and evolution equations.

sources.title: Solution of quantum Dirac constraints via path integral

evidence.text: Derive on-shell Ward identities from classical gauge invariance, retaining boundary terms explicitly. Use them to cancel gauge variations between gauge-field and ghost determinants, with the local measure included.

sources.title: Kinematics of arbitrary spin matter fields in loop quantum gravity

evidence.text: Classical analysis uses a 3+1 split, Legendre transformation and half-density matter variables. For the scalar field, redistributing density weight changes the symplectic structure and requires a corresponding shift of the Ashtekar connection.

sources.title: Kinematics of arbitrary spin matter fields in loop quantum gravity

evidence.text: SU(2) representation theory constructs the spin-j singlet intertwiner from symmetrized fundamental epsilon tensors. Recoupling into three-valent Wigner intertwiners exposes exchange phases, including (−1)^(2j+l).

sources.title: Consistent canonical quantization of gravity: Recovery of classical GR from BRST-invariant coherent states

evidence.text: Motivates the Hamiltonian through a schematic phase-space path integral: conjugate momenta are introduced by Gaussian integration because the Hamiltonian is at most quadratic in momenta. The initial Lagrangian discussion suppresses noncanonical kinetic-measure contributions.

sources.title: Ostrogradsky's Theorem is Incompatible with Background Independence in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Does an exactly enforced gravitational Hamiltonian constraint invalidate applying Ostrogradsky's instability argument to background-independent quantum gravity, and what limits does this place on weak-field graviton descriptions?

sources.title: Deformed General Relativity and Effective Actions from Loop Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: What effective actions and space-time interpretations follow from a consistently deformed hypersurface-deformation algebra motivated by loop quantum gravity, and how do inverse-triad and holonomy effects differ?

sources.title: Quantum gravity with a positive cosmological constant

evidence.text: Can loop quantum gravity in 3+1 dimensions with positive cosmological constant supply a physical vacuum, recover low-energy gravity and matter, and explain horizon information bounds?

sources.title: An Invitation to loop quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can quantum spacetime be constructed from the established principles of general relativity and quantum mechanics, using background-independent gauge quantization, and yield physical predictions?

sources.title: Nakanishi–Kugo–Ojima quantization of general relativity in Heisenberg picture

evidence.text: Can four-dimensional pure gravity be canonically quantized in the Heisenberg picture using co-Poincaré geometry and Nakanishi–Kugo–Ojima quantization, yielding a positive physical sector and unitary transitions? Does this motivate reconsidering renormalizability?

sources.title: Batalin-Fradkin-Vilkovisky quantization of quadratic gravity

evidence.text: How can quadratic gravity be quantized through its constrained Hamiltonian using BFV, while incorporating the additional condition required for Hamiltonian–Lagrangian equivalence, and how do its negative-norm modes appear in the resulting propagators?

sources.title: QSD 6: Quantum Poincare algebra and a quantum positivity of energy theorem for canonical quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can asymptotic gravitational energy and the stated little subgroup of Poincaré symmetry be quantized in the real connection representation, with a well-defined positive energy operator and an anomaly-free symmetry algebra under suitable quantum boundary conditions?

sources.title: Anomaly freedom in effective loop quantum cosmology: Pedagogical summary and generalized holonomy corrections

evidence.text: When do generalized holonomy corrections preserve a first-class constraint algebra for effective cosmological perturbations, what counterterms are required, and does correcting background curvature inside perturbative constraints add physical effects?

sources.title: Quantum Geometry and Black Holes

evidence.text: How does loop quantization of spherically symmetric gravity define physical states and quantum metrics, address black-hole singularities, and constrain covariance and possible ringdown signatures? This chapter reviews earlier work.
